bio.text: Jeff Keicher, a Republican, represents the 70th District in the Illinois House of Representatives, a seat Keicher has held since July 2018.
According to the General Assembly biography, Keicher is an insurance agent and entrepreneur with a political science degree from Northern Illinois University.
The biography lists Keicher as a past president of the Sycamore Rotary Club and a past board member of the Kishwaukee YMCA and the DeKalb County American Red Cross.
